name: Orphan
overview: Scripture reveals a compassionate mandate to protect orphans and widows, emphasizing that God hears their cries and will bring judgment against those who afflict them, as seen in Exodus 22:22-24. The narrative of the daughters of Zelophehad in Numbers 27:1 highlights God's provision and justice for those without traditional family protection. Additionally, the genealogy of Lot in Genesis 11:27-28 reminds us of the human realities behind these vulnerable individuals, grounding the call to care for orphans in real historical contexts.
